set.request: 336px-tall .tabs.block .tab-bar on /framework/ext/catalog/ at 390 (341 at 720, normal 57 at 1280) — a blank grey band no LayoutTool rule catches. Also: page title spills 88px/23% past its container at 390 on the same page. Reproduce, decide what a tab bar should do on a phone, fix at the right rung, verify across other Doc pages, describe the rule gap. Dispatched by mastermind-layout.
steps: Decide what a tab bar should do on a phone
Fix at the right rung, in fence
Verify the title escape is covered
Verify across a sample of Doc pages + real catalog() callers, 4 widths
Describe the LayoutTool rule gap (no code)
set.outcome: **Fixed: the 336px tab-bar band was a class-name collision, not a tabs design flaw.** `/framework/ext/catalog/`'s own Doc page happens to have route segment "catalog", so Page.render()'s `page-<name>` stamp gave it the class `page-catalog` -- colliding with the REAL `.page-catalog` class this module's own rail/strip layout owns. catalog.css's mobile media query flipped that collided element's flex-direction to column, turning doc.css's `.tab-bar { flex: 1 1 24em }` (a width basis) into a height basis: 24em x mobile font-size = 336px (390) / 341px (720), with the tab row pinned to its bottom edge -- never wrapped rows, contrary to the dispatch's working theory. The 88px/23% title escape on the same page was the identical bug (the title's box lost its row-mode width constraint too). One-line fix in fence, catalog.css:145 -- added the SAME `:where(:not(.page))` guard the unaffected base-layer rule (catalog.css:15) already carries for this exact collision. Both bugs gone with one change; verified at 390/720/1280/3440 on /framework/ext/catalog/, plus no regression on core/App and core/View (Doc pages never affected) and no regression on real catalog() callers (framework/ui/, framework/styles/sections/ -- mobile strip / desktop rail both intact). No redesign: tabs.css's existing decision (horizontal-scroll strip, never wrap individual tabs) and doc.css's existing decision (wrap the WHOLE bar below the title when it doesn't fit) were both already correct, just never reached. LayoutTool rule gap described in the log (not added, out of fence): no rule compares a container's own height against its children's collective content height with children edge-anchored -- the shape that let a self-consistent 336px blank box (nothing overflowing, nothing off-viewport) pass every existing check.
